dno_dashboard.subtitle: 5 Elektro DSOs · ~1.0 M LV customers · 12 NUTS-3 regions · 212 občine
dno_dashboard.intro: Slovenia's distribution is split across five regional Elektro DSOs coordinated by SODO holding, with very different operating profiles. Elektro Ljubljana (33% share) covers the Osrednjeslovenska capital region plus parts of Gorenjska/Posavska/JV Slovenija; Elektro Maribor (25%) covers Podravska/Pomurska/Koroška including the Drava cascade; Elektro Celje (20%) is the Savinja Valley operator most exposed to the 2023 floods; Elektro Primorska (14%) operates the Adriatic coast and karst plateau; Elektro Gorenjska (8%) covers the Alpine valleys.

dsos.name: Elektro Primorska

dsos.name: Elektro Gorenjska
dsos.coverage: Gorenjska (Kranj–Triglav). Alpine valleys — narrow-valley restoration speed challenges.

saidi.headline: Slovenia's national SAIDI (~38 min/customer/year, AGEN-RS 2024) sits in the middle of the European range — better than Hungary (~57) and Poland (~95), worse than Germany (~12) and the Netherlands (~24). Urban Ljubljana achieves ~18 min (Elektro Ljubljana underground sections), while rural NE/SE territories average ~55 min (Elektro Maribor / Elektro Celje exposed to 2023-style flood events).

notes.heading: Krško NPP — Distribution-Side Impact on 5 DSOs
notes.body: Although Krško NPP is a transmission-level asset (operated by NEK / GEN Energija, dispatched by ELES), its single-unit nature affects DSO-level reliability via balancing reserve obligations. A Krško forced outage cascades to all 5 Elektro DSOs simultaneously. URSJV oversees nuclear safety; AGEN-RS handles the grid-side compensation arrangements.

deep_dive.label: Savinja Valley
deep_dive.narrative: The corridor median R reflects the tension between Krško NPP baseload inflexibility, rapidly growing renewable variability, and aging grid infrastructure built for 1970s load profiles. The SSI flags continuity-of-supply deficits, infrastructure age mismatches with modern demand patterns, and grid modernization lag under Slovenia Digital 2030 timelines.
